method: Published Medicare figures only; nothing in this file is estimated. Each fee is [services, average Medicare allowed amount, average billed amount] in dollars. A state's figure is kept when it rests on at least 50 services.

hospital.title: Medicare Outpatient Hospitals - by Geography and Service

center.title: Ambulatory Surgical Center Payment: Addendum AA, ASC Covered Surgical Procedures

schedule.title: Physician Fee Schedule: National Relative Value File (RVU26D)

doctor.source: KFF, How Much More Than Medicare Do Private Insurers Pay? A Review of the Literature (2020)
doctor.quote: For physician services, private insurance paid 143% of Medicare rates, on average, ranging from 118% to 179% of Medicare rates across studies.
doctor.range: The lowest and highest averages among the studies KFF reviewed.

center.source: RAND, Prices Paid to Hospitals by Private Health Plans: Findings from Round 5.1 of an Employer-Led Transparency Initiative (RR-A1144-2-v2, December 2024; 2022 prices)
center.quote: In 2022, prices for common outpatient services performed in ASCs averaged 170 percent of Medicare prices but, because of differences in Medicare payment models between ASCs and HOPDs, would have averaged approximately 107 percent of Medicare prices if paid using Medicare payment rates for HOPDs.
center.range: Our own assumption, not a published range: from Medicare's own surgery center price up to what hospital outpatient departments average (279%). RAND reports only state averages, which ran from below Medicare's price in Nevada and Arkansas to nearly 460% in New Jersey (page 20).

hospital.source: RAND, Prices Paid to Hospitals by Private Health Plans: Findings from Round 5.1 of an Employer-Led Transparency Initiative (RR-A1144-2-v2, December 2024; 2022 prices)
hospital.quote: That year, relative prices for inpatient hospital facility services averaged 254 percent of Medicare prices, outpatient hospital facility services averaged 279 percent, and all associated professional services (inpatient plus outpatient) averaged 184 percent of what Medicare would have paid for the same services.
hospital.range: The best guess is RAND's figure; the range is from a different source, the outpatient hospital studies KFF reviewed in 2020, which ranged from 150% to 358% and averaged 264%. The 358% is a single study of Indiana, a state with few competing hospital systems.
hospital.range_source: KFF, How Much More Than Medicare Do Private Insurers Pay? A Review of the Literature (2020)

anesthesia.source: Duffy, Ly, Adler and Trish, Commercial and Medicare Advantage Payment for Anesthesiology Services, American Journal of Managed Care 27(6), 2021 (2016 and 2017 claims from three large insurers)
anesthesia.quote: Mean in-network commercial allowed amount CFs for anesthesiology services ($70) are 314% of the traditional Medicare rate ($22)
anesthesia.range: The study gives one average, so it is both the best guess and the low end. The high end (397%) is from the American Society of Anesthesiologists' 2025 survey of commercial fees, which we could not read ourselves; a billing company's summary of it reports a national average commercial rate of $82.43 a unit against Medicare's $20.77. Both sources compare rates per unit ("CFs", conversion factors), not whole bills.
anesthesia.range_source: Coronis Health, A New Year's Revelation: Survey Discloses Commercial Payment Patterns (January 2026), summarizing the ASA survey
anesthesia.range_quote: In contrast, the 2024 national Medicare CF for anesthesia services was $20.77, or 25.2% of the contemporaneous mean commercial CF reported.

procedures.name: Upper eyelid surgery (blepharoplasty)
procedures.about: Removes extra skin and fat from one upper eyelid, often because it droops into the line of sight.
procedures.note: Priced per eyelid. For both eyes on the same day, the second is usually billed at about half.

cosmetic.quote: The average cost of cosmetic eyelid surgery is $3,359 for an upper blepharoplasty
cosmetic.excludes: it does not include anesthesia, operating room facilities or other related expenses

procedures.medicare_description: Removal of excessive skin and fat of upper eyelid

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for procedure on eyelid

procedures.name: Droopy eyelid repair (ptosis repair)
procedures.about: Tightens the muscle that lifts one upper eyelid, so the lid itself sits higher.
procedures.note: Priced per eyelid. For both eyes on the same day, the second is usually billed at about half.
procedures.medicare_description: Repair of tendon of upper eyelid

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for procedure on eyelid

procedures.name: Cataract surgery with a lens implant
procedures.about: Replaces the eye's clouded lens with a clear artificial one. One eye.
procedures.note: A standard lens is included. Premium lenses (for astigmatism or to reduce the need for glasses) are an extra charge that insurance does not cover.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of cataract with insertion of prosthetic lens

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for lens surgery

procedures.name: Laser to clear cloudiness after cataract surgery (YAG)
procedures.about: A few-minute laser treatment that opens the cloudy film that can form behind a lens implant.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of recurring cataract in lens capsule using a laser

procedures.name: Laser treatment for glaucoma (SLT)
procedures.about: A laser treatment to the eye's drain that lowers eye pressure. One eye.
procedures.medicare_description: Laser repair to improve eye fluid flow

procedures.name: Eye injection for macular degeneration or diabetic eye disease
procedures.about: An injection of medicine into the eye, usually repeated every one to three months.
procedures.note: This is the fee for giving the injection only. The drug is billed separately and can cost far more than the injection, depending on which one is used.
procedures.medicare_description: Injection of drug into eye

procedures.name: Stye or eyelid bump removal (chalazion)
procedures.about: Opens and drains one stubborn bump in the eyelid.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of chronic growth of eyelid

procedures.name: Pterygium removal with a graft
procedures.about: Removes a growth of tissue from the surface of the eye and covers the spot with a graft.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal or relocation of corneal conjunctiva with graft

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on eye

procedures.name: Skin biopsy (shave)
procedures.about: Shaves off one spot of skin to send to a lab.
procedures.note: The lab that reads the sample bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Biopsy of related skin growth, first growth

procedures.name: Skin biopsy (punch)
procedures.about: Takes one small, deeper core of skin to send to a lab, usually closed with a stitch.
procedures.note: The lab that reads the sample bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Punch biopsy, first skin growth

procedures.name: Mohs surgery for skin cancer (face, scalp, hands, feet)
procedures.about: Removes a skin cancer one thin layer at a time, checking each layer under the microscope the same day.
procedures.note: This is the first layer (stage). Many cases need a second stage, billed in addition, and closing the wound with a flap or graft is billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal and microscopic exam of growth of head, neck, hands, feet, or genitals, 1-5 tissue blocks

procedures.name: Freezing a precancerous spot (actinic keratosis)
procedures.about: Freezes one rough, sun-damaged spot with liquid nitrogen.
procedures.note: This is the first spot. Each additional spot the same day adds a much smaller fee, and 15 or more are billed as one flat fee.
procedures.medicare_description: Destruction of precancer skin growth, 1 growth

procedures.name: Wart removal (up to 14)
procedures.about: Destroys up to 14 warts or similar harmless growths in one visit, usually by freezing.
procedures.medicare_description: Destruction of skin growth, 1-14 growths

procedures.name: Skin cancer cut out (face, about 1/2 to 3/4 inch)
procedures.about: Cuts out a skin cancer on the face, ears, eyelids, nose or lips, 1.1 to 2.0 cm across with its margin, and stitches it closed.
procedures.note: Larger or smaller cancers and other body areas have their own codes, generally within a few hundred dollars of this one. The lab bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of cancer skin growth of face, ears, eyelids, nose, lips, or mouth, 1.1-2.0 cm

procedures.name: Cyst or benign lump cut out (body, arms or legs)
procedures.about: Cuts out a harmless growth 1.1 to 2.0 cm across on the trunk, arms or legs and stitches it closed.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of noncancer skin growth of body, arms, or legs, 1.1-2.0 cm

procedures.name: Skin tag removal (up to 15)
procedures.about: Removes up to 15 skin tags in one visit.
procedures.note: Insurers usually treat skin tag removal as cosmetic unless the tags bleed or are irritated.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of skin tag, 1-15 skin tags

procedures.name: Draining a boil or abscess
procedures.about: Opens and drains one simple pocket of infection under the skin.
procedures.medicare_description: Simple or single drainage of skin abscess

procedures.name: Ingrown toenail removal (permanent)
procedures.about: Removes part or all of a toenail along with its root, so that edge does not grow back.
procedures.medicare_description: Permanent removal fingernail or toenail

procedures.name: Ear tubes
procedures.about: Places a tiny tube in one eardrum under general anesthesia so fluid can drain.
procedures.note: Medicare's figures come mostly from adults; this is most often a children's surgery, and private prices for children may differ.
procedures.medicare_description: Incision of eardrum with placement of eardrum tube under general anesthesia

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for incision of ear drum

procedures.name: Tonsil removal (age 12 and up)
procedures.about: Removes the tonsils in a teenager or adult.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of tonsils (12 years or older)

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on mouth

procedures.name: Deviated septum repair (septoplasty)
procedures.about: Straightens the wall between the nostrils to open the airway.
procedures.note: This is not a nose job: reshaping the outside of the nose (rhinoplasty) is a separate, usually cosmetic, charge.
procedures.medicare_description: Reshaping of nasal cartilage

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on nose and sinuses

procedures.name: Sinus surgery (endoscopic)
procedures.about: Opens the ethmoid sinuses on one side through the nostril, using a scope.
procedures.note: Sinus surgery is billed per sinus and per side, and most operations open several. Expect the doctor's fee for a typical both-sides operation to be a multiple of this one.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of nasal sinus using an endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on nose and sinuses

procedures.name: Scope exam of the nose and sinuses
procedures.about: A thin scope passed through the nostrils in the office to look at the nasal passages and sinus openings.
procedures.note: Usually billed on top of an office visit.
procedures.medicare_description: Diagnostic exam of nasal passages using an endoscope

procedures.name: Earwax removal by a clinician
procedures.about: Removes impacted earwax with instruments, for one or both ears.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of impacted ear wax

procedures.name: Colonoscopy
procedures.about: A scope exam of the whole colon, with nothing removed.
procedures.note: A routine screening colonoscopy is free under most insurance plans. If the doctor takes a biopsy or removes a polyp, the price rises and a lab bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Diagnostic exam of large bowel using a flexible endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on large bowel using an endoscope

procedures.name: Colonoscopy with polyp removal
procedures.about: A scope exam of the whole colon in which one or more polyps are removed with a wire loop.
procedures.note: The lab that examines the polyps bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of polyps or growths of large bowel using an endoscope with mechanical snare

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on large bowel using an endoscope

procedures.name: Upper endoscopy (EGD) with biopsy
procedures.about: A scope exam of the esophagus, stomach and first part of the small intestine, with small tissue samples taken.
procedures.note: The lab that examines the samples bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Biopsy of esophagus, stomach, and/or upper small bowel using a flexible endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on esophagus, stomach, or upper small bowel using an endoscope

procedures.name: Hemorrhoid banding
procedures.about: Places a small rubber band around a hemorrhoid in the office so it shrinks and falls off.
procedures.note: Often takes two or three sessions, each billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of external hemorrhoids by rubber banding

procedures.name: Gallbladder removal (laparoscopic)
procedures.about: Removes the gallbladder through a few small cuts, usually going home the same day.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of gallbladder using an endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on upper abdomen

procedures.name: Groin hernia repair (open)
procedures.about: Repairs a first-time hernia in the groin through one cut, usually with mesh. One side.
procedures.medicare_description: Repair of groin hernia (5 years or older)

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other repair of lower abdomen hernia (1 year or older)

procedures.name: Groin hernia repair (laparoscopic)
procedures.about: Repairs a first-time hernia in the groin through a few small cuts using a camera. One side.
procedures.medicare_description: Repair of groin hernia using an endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on lower abdomen

procedures.name: Knee arthroscopy for a torn meniscus
procedures.about: Trims a torn meniscus through two or three small cuts using a camera.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of knee cartilage using an endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure or exam of knee joint using an endoscope

procedures.name: Carpal tunnel release
procedures.about: Cuts the ligament pressing on the nerve at the wrist. One hand.
procedures.note: Often done with only local numbing, in which case there is no anesthesia bill.
procedures.medicare_description: Release and/or relocation of hand nerve

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for procedure on nerves, muscles, tendons, and tissue of forearm, wrist, and hand

procedures.name: Trigger finger release
procedures.about: Opens the tight sheath that catches the tendon of one finger.
procedures.medicare_description: Incision of tendon covering of finger

procedures.name: Rotator cuff repair (arthroscopic)
procedures.about: Reattaches a torn shoulder tendon to bone through small cuts using a camera.
procedures.note: Other work done at the same time (shaving bone, biceps tendon) is billed in addition. Physical therapy afterward is separate.
procedures.medicare_description: Repair of shoulder rotator cuff using an endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on top of arm bone and shoulder joint

procedures.name: ACL reconstruction
procedures.about: Rebuilds the knee's torn front ligament with a tendon graft, using a camera.
procedures.note: Medicare's figures come from few, older patients; this surgery is far more common in young adults on private insurance. A donor graft, a brace and physical therapy are separate.
procedures.medicare_description: Repair of anterior cruciate ligament of knee using an endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure or exam of knee joint using an endoscope

procedures.name: Total knee replacement
procedures.about: Replaces the worn surfaces of the knee joint with metal and plastic.
procedures.note: Covers the surgery day. An overnight hospital stay, physical therapy and any rehab stay are separate.
procedures.medicare_description: Replacement of knee joint, both sides of knee

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for procedure for total knee joint replacement

procedures.name: Total hip replacement
procedures.about: Replaces the ball and socket of the hip joint.
procedures.note: Covers the surgery day. An overnight hospital stay, physical therapy and any rehab stay are separate.
procedures.medicare_description: Replacement of thigh bone and hip joint with prosthesis

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for total hip replacement

procedures.name: Bunion surgery
procedures.about: Cuts and realigns the bone at the base of the big toe. One foot.
procedures.medicare_description: Correction of bunion with alignment correction of midfoot bone toward toe area

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on lower leg, ankle, and foot bones

procedures.name: Cortisone shot in a large joint (knee, shoulder, hip)
procedures.about: An injection into, or fluid drained from, a knee, shoulder or hip, without ultrasound guidance.
procedures.note: Usually billed on top of an office visit. Cortisone itself costs little; gel (hyaluronic acid) injections are a much more expensive drug, billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Aspiration and/or injection of fluid from large joint

procedures.name: Epidural steroid injection (lower back)
procedures.about: A steroid injection into the space around the spinal nerves of the lower back, guided by X-ray.
procedures.medicare_description: Injection of substance into lower spine canal using imaging guidance

procedures.name: Nerve root injection (lower back, transforaminal)
procedures.about: A steroid injection beside one specific nerve where it leaves the lower spine, guided by X-ray.
procedures.note: Priced for one level on one side. Each additional level is billed in addition.
procedures.medicare_description: Injection of anesthetic and/or steroid drug into sacral spine nerve root using imaging guidance, single level

procedures.name: Bladder scope exam (cystoscopy)
procedures.about: A thin scope passed through the urethra to look inside the bladder, usually in the office.
procedures.medicare_description: Diagnostic exam of bladder and urethra using an endoscope

procedures.name: Prostate biopsy
procedures.about: Takes needle samples of the prostate.
procedures.note: The ultrasound used to guide the needle and the lab that reads the samples bill separately; the lab is often the largest part of the bill.

retired.note: Billing code 55700 was retired in 2026 and replaced by a set of codes, 55705 to 55715, one for each way of doing the biopsy. The figures here are from 2024, under the old code.

procedures.medicare_description: Biopsy of prostate gland

procedures.name: Kidney stone removal with scope and laser
procedures.about: Passes a scope up to the stone, breaks it with a laser and leaves a temporary stent. One side.
procedures.medicare_description: Crushing of stone of ureter with insertion of stent using an endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for fragmenting, manipulation and/or removal of kidney stone including use of an endoscope

procedures.name: Kidney stone shock wave treatment (lithotripsy)
procedures.about: Breaks a kidney stone from outside the body with focused shock waves.
procedures.medicare_description: Shock wave crushing of kidney stones

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for shock wave therapy for urinary system stones without water bath

procedures.name: Colposcopy with biopsy
procedures.about: A magnified look at the cervix after an abnormal Pap test, with small samples taken.
procedures.note: The lab that reads the samples bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Biopsy and scraping of cervix using an endoscope

procedures.name: Endometrial biopsy
procedures.about: Takes a small sample of the lining of the uterus in the office.
procedures.note: The lab that reads the sample bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Biopsy of lining of uterus

procedures.name: Hysteroscopy with biopsy or polyp removal
procedures.about: A scope exam inside the uterus in which the lining is sampled or a polyp is removed.
procedures.medicare_description: Biopsy of lining of uterus and/or removal of polyp using an endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for exam of uterus using an endoscope

procedures.name: Breast biopsy (needle, ultrasound-guided)
procedures.about: Takes needle samples of one spot in the breast, guided by ultrasound, and leaves a tiny marker.
procedures.note: The lab that reads the samples bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Biopsy of breast and placement of locating device using ultrasound, first growth

procedures.name: Lumpectomy (partial mastectomy)
procedures.about: Removes a breast cancer with a rim of normal tissue, keeping the rest of the breast.
procedures.note: Checking the lymph nodes at the same time, the lab work and any radiation afterward are billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Partial removal of breast

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on skin of arms, legs, and front body

procedures.name: Echocardiogram (heart ultrasound)
procedures.about: A complete ultrasound of the heart through the chest wall, with Doppler.
procedures.note: Done in a hospital, the hospital adds its own fee, which is usually much larger; ask where it will be done.
procedures.medicare_description: Ultrasound of heart with color-depicted blood flow, rate, direction and valve function

procedures.name: Treadmill stress test
procedures.about: An EKG recorded while walking on a treadmill, with a doctor supervising and reading it. No imaging.
procedures.note: A stress test with imaging (nuclear or echo) is a different, much more expensive test.
procedures.medicare_description: Exercise or drug-induced heart stress test with electrocardiogram (ecg) with supervision and review by physician

procedures.name: Varicose vein treatment (radiofrequency ablation)
procedures.about: Seals the main faulty vein in one leg with heat from a thin catheter, in the office.
procedures.note: Priced for the first vein. Insurers cover it only when the veins cause symptoms, not for appearance.
procedures.medicare_description: Destruction of first incompetent vein of arm or leg using radiofrequency and imaging guidance

procedures.name: Heart catheterization (coronary angiogram)
procedures.about: Threads a catheter to the heart to take X-ray pictures of its arteries and measure pressures.
procedures.note: If a blockage is opened with a stent at the same time, the total is several times higher.
procedures.medicare_description: Insertion of tube in left lower heart chamber and coronary artery for diagnosis with review by radiologist

procedures.name: MRI of a knee, hip or ankle (no contrast)
procedures.about: An MRI of one leg joint without contrast dye, including the radiologist's reading.
procedures.note: The same scan usually costs far less at a freestanding imaging center than at a hospital. If your doctor orders one, you can ask to have it done at an imaging center.
procedures.medicare_description: Mri scan of leg joint without contrast

procedures.name: MRI of the brain (no contrast)
procedures.about: An MRI of the brain without contrast dye, including the radiologist's reading.
procedures.note: The same scan usually costs far less at a freestanding imaging center than at a hospital. If your doctor orders one, you can ask to have it done at an imaging center.
procedures.medicare_description: Mri scan of brain without contrast

procedures.name: MRI of the lower back (no contrast)
procedures.about: An MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast dye, including the radiologist's reading.
procedures.note: The same scan usually costs far less at a freestanding imaging center than at a hospital. If your doctor orders one, you can ask to have it done at an imaging center.
procedures.medicare_description: Mri scan of lower spinal canal without contrast

procedures.name: CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis (with contrast)
procedures.about: A CT scan of the belly and pelvis with contrast dye, including the radiologist's reading.
procedures.note: The same scan usually costs far less at a freestanding imaging center than at a hospital. In an emergency room, the visit itself is billed on top of the scan.
procedures.medicare_description: Ct scan of abdomen and pelvis with contrast

procedures.name: Screening mammogram (3D not included)
procedures.about: Routine X-ray screening of both breasts, including the radiologist's reading.
procedures.note: Free under most insurance plans. 3D imaging (tomosynthesis) adds a smaller separate charge.
procedures.medicare_description: Screening mammography

procedures.name: Overnight sleep study in a lab
procedures.about: A night in a sleep lab with brain, breathing and oxygen monitoring, to diagnose sleep apnea and other disorders.
procedures.note: A home sleep apnea test is far cheaper, and many insurers require it first.
procedures.medicare_description: Sleep study in sleep lab (6 years or older)

procedures.name: EMG needle test of one arm or leg
procedures.about: A needle test of the muscles in one limb, done along with nerve conduction studies.
procedures.note: This is billed on top of the nerve conduction studies done the same visit, which usually cost a similar amount again.
procedures.medicare_description: Needle measurement of electrical activity in arm or leg muscles, complete study

procedures.name: Thyroid nodule biopsy (fine needle, ultrasound-guided)
procedures.about: Draws cells from one nodule through a thin needle, guided by ultrasound.
procedures.note: The lab that reads the sample bills separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Fine needle aspiration biopsy using ultrasound guidance, first growth

procedures.name: Botox injections for chronic migraine
procedures.about: A set of small injections around the head and neck, repeated every 12 weeks.
procedures.note: This is the fee for giving the injections. The drug is billed separately and costs far more than the injections.
procedures.medicare_description: Injection of chemical for paralysis of facial and neck nerve muscles on both sides of face

procedures.name: Doctor's visit, returning patient (20 to 29 minutes)
procedures.about: A routine visit with a doctor or nurse practitioner you have seen before, for one or two straightforward problems.
procedures.note: Tests, shots and procedures done at the visit are billed separately. A yearly preventive checkup is a different kind of visit: most health plans must cover a set of preventive services at no cost to you, generally when the provider is in your plan's network.
procedures.medicare_description: Established patient office or other outpatient visit with low level od decision making, if using time, 20 minutes or more

procedures.name: Doctor's visit, returning patient (30 to 39 minutes)
procedures.about: A longer visit with a doctor or nurse practitioner you have seen before, for several problems or one that needs more working out.
procedures.note: Tests, shots and procedures done at the visit are billed separately. A yearly preventive checkup is a different kind of visit: most health plans must cover a set of preventive services at no cost to you, generally when the provider is in your plan's network.
procedures.medicare_description: Established patient office or other outpatient visit with moderate level of decision making, if using time, 30 minutes or more

procedures.name: Doctor's visit, new patient (30 to 44 minutes)
procedures.about: A first visit with a doctor or practice you haven't been to in the last three years. Specialists bill a first visit the same way.
procedures.note: Tests, shots and procedures done at the visit are billed separately. A yearly preventive checkup is a different kind of visit: most health plans must cover a set of preventive services at no cost to you, generally when the provider is in your plan's network.
procedures.medicare_description: New patient office or other outpatient visit with low level of medical decision making, if using time, 30 minutes or more

procedures.name: Doctor's visit, new patient (45 to 59 minutes)
procedures.about: A longer first visit with a doctor or practice you haven't been to in the last three years.
procedures.note: Tests, shots and procedures done at the visit are billed separately. A yearly preventive checkup is a different kind of visit: most health plans must cover a set of preventive services at no cost to you, generally when the provider is in your plan's network.
procedures.medicare_description: New patient office or other outpatient visit with moderate level of medical decision making, if using time, 45 minutes or more

procedures.name: Stitches for a small cut (up to 1 inch)
procedures.about: Closes a simple cut of up to 2.5 cm on the scalp, neck, body, arms or legs.
procedures.note: The visit itself is billed on top of the stitches. In an emergency room, the hospital bills its own fee as well.
procedures.medicare_description: Simple repair of surface wound of scalp, neck, underarms, trunk, arms, or legs, 2.5 cm or less

procedures.name: Eye exam, returning patient (comprehensive)
procedures.about: A full medical eye exam by an optometrist or ophthalmologist you have seen before.
procedures.note: The check for a glasses prescription (refraction) and a contact lens fitting are separate charges.
procedures.medicare_description: Established patient complete exam of visual system

procedures.name: Eye exam, new patient (comprehensive)
procedures.about: A full medical eye exam at a practice you haven't been to before.
procedures.note: The check for a glasses prescription (refraction) and a contact lens fitting are separate charges.
procedures.medicare_description: New patient complete exam of visual system

procedures.name: Hearing test (comprehensive)
procedures.about: Measures how well you hear tones and speech in each ear, in a sound booth.
procedures.note: Hearing aids and their fitting are separate. Medicare doesn't cover hearing aids or the exams for fitting them.
procedures.medicare_description: Comprehensive hearing and speech recognition test

procedures.name: Electrocardiogram (ECG or EKG)
procedures.about: A few minutes' recording of the heart's electrical rhythm, with a doctor's reading.
procedures.note: Usually done during a visit, which is billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Routine electrocardiogram (ecg) using at least 12 leads with interpretation and report

procedures.name: Ultrasound of the neck arteries (carotid)
procedures.about: An ultrasound of the arteries on both sides of the neck, looking for narrowing.
procedures.medicare_description: Ultrasound of both sides of head and neck blood flow

procedures.name: Breathing test (spirometry)
procedures.about: Measures how much air you can blow out and how fast.
procedures.medicare_description: Test to measure expiratory airflow and volume

procedures.name: Breathing test before and after an inhaler
procedures.about: The same breathing test done twice, before and after a dose of inhaled medicine, to see whether it opens the airways.
procedures.medicare_description: Test to measure expiratory airflow and volume changes before and after medication administration

procedures.name: Scope exam of the lungs (bronchoscopy)
procedures.about: A thin camera passed through the nose or mouth to look inside the airways, without taking samples.
procedures.note: Taking biopsies or washings is billed under different codes and costs more.
procedures.medicare_description: Diagnostic exam of lung airway using an endoscope

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other closed procedure on chest

procedures.name: EEG (brain wave test), awake and drowsy
procedures.about: Records the brain's electrical activity through sensors on the scalp for 20 to 40 minutes.
procedures.medicare_description: Measurement of brain wave activity (eeg), awake and drowsy

procedures.name: Allergy skin test (per allergen)
procedures.about: A tiny amount of one allergen pricked into the skin to see whether it raises a bump.
procedures.note: Priced per allergen, and a visit tests many at once. Multiply by the number tested. The visit itself is billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Test for allergy using allergenic extract

procedures.name: Allergy shot (one injection)
procedures.about: Giving one allergy injection. Shots are given on a schedule over months or years.
procedures.note: The allergy serum itself is billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Professional service for single injection of allergen

procedures.name: Allergy shots (two or more injections)
procedures.about: Giving two or more allergy injections at one visit.
procedures.note: The allergy serum itself is billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Professional service for multiple injections of allergen

procedures.name: Trimming thick or fungal toenails (6 or more)
procedures.about: Thinning and cutting back six or more toenails that are too thick or diseased to trim at home.
procedures.note: Medicare doesn't usually cover routine foot care such as trimming nails or removing corns and calluses. It covers a podiatrist's treatment when it is medically necessary for a foot injury or disease. Ask your own plan what it covers.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of fingernails or toenails, 6 or more nails

procedures.name: Trimming corns or calluses (2 to 4)
procedures.about: Paring down two to four corns or calluses.
procedures.note: Medicare doesn't usually cover routine foot care such as trimming nails or removing corns and calluses. It covers a podiatrist's treatment when it is medically necessary for a foot injury or disease. Ask your own plan what it covers.
procedures.medicare_description: Removal of noncancer thickened skin growth, 2-4 growths

procedures.name: Injection for plantar fasciitis or a sore tendon
procedures.about: A steroid injection into the band of tissue under the heel, or around one tendon.
procedures.note: The visit itself is billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Injection into tendon or ligament

procedures.name: Hammertoe surgery (one toe)
procedures.about: Straightens one bent toe by removing a small piece of bone or fusing the joint.
procedures.medicare_description: Correction of toe joint deformity

anesthesia.medicare_description: Anesthesia for other procedure on lower leg, ankle, and foot bones

procedures.name: First visit with a therapist or psychiatrist (evaluation)
procedures.about: The first appointment: a full conversation about what is going on and what treatment might help, without prescribing.
procedures.note: Therapists who don't take insurance set their own cash rates, which Medicare's figures don't show.
procedures.medicare_description: Psychiatric diagnostic evaluation

procedures.name: Therapy session (45 minutes)
procedures.about: A one-to-one talk therapy session of 38 to 52 minutes.
procedures.note: Therapists who don't take insurance set their own cash rates, which Medicare's figures don't show.
procedures.medicare_description: Psychotherapy, 45 minutes

procedures.name: Therapy session (60 minutes)
procedures.about: A one-to-one talk therapy session of 53 minutes or more.
procedures.note: Therapists who don't take insurance set their own cash rates, which Medicare's figures don't show.
procedures.medicare_description: Psychotherapy, 1 hour

procedures.name: Physical therapy evaluation (first visit)
procedures.about: The first appointment, for a straightforward problem: the therapist examines you and sets a treatment plan.
procedures.note: More complicated problems are billed under two higher evaluation codes.
procedures.medicare_description: Evaluation for physical therapy, typically 20 minutes

procedures.name: Physical therapy: guided exercise (per 15 minutes)
procedures.about: Exercises for strength, range of motion or flexibility, done with the therapist.
procedures.note: Billed in 15-minute units, and a session is made up of several units, often of different kinds. Multiply by the number of units to estimate a session.
procedures.medicare_description: Therapy procedure using exercise to develop strength, endurance, range of motion, and flexibility, each 15 minutes

procedures.name: Physical therapy: hands-on treatment (per 15 minutes)
procedures.about: The therapist moves or works on joints and soft tissue by hand.
procedures.note: Billed in 15-minute units, and a session is made up of several units, often of different kinds. Multiply by the number of units to estimate a session.
procedures.medicare_description: Therapy procedure using manual technique, each 15 minutes

procedures.name: Chiropractic adjustment (1 or 2 regions of the spine)
procedures.about: A chiropractor's adjustment of one or two regions of the spine.
procedures.note: From a chiropractor, Medicare covers only adjustments of the spine. It doesn't cover X-rays or other services or tests the chiropractor orders, and those are billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Chiropractic manipulative treatment, 1-2 spinal regions

procedures.name: Chiropractic adjustment (3 or 4 regions of the spine)
procedures.about: A chiropractor's adjustment of three or four regions of the spine.
procedures.note: From a chiropractor, Medicare covers only adjustments of the spine. It doesn't cover X-rays or other services or tests the chiropractor orders, and those are billed separately.
procedures.medicare_description: Chiropractic manipulative treatment, 3-4 spinal regions

procedures.name: Chest X-ray (2 views)
procedures.about: Two X-ray pictures of the chest, front and side.
procedures.note: Includes the radiologist's reading.
procedures.medicare_description: X-ray of chest, 2 views

procedures.name: Knee X-ray (3 views)
procedures.about: Three X-ray pictures of one knee.
procedures.note: Includes the radiologist's reading.
procedures.medicare_description: X-ray of knee, 3 views

procedures.name: Bone density scan (DEXA)
procedures.about: A low-dose X-ray scan of the hip and spine that measures bone strength.
procedures.note: Includes the radiologist's reading.
procedures.medicare_description: Dxa bone density measurement of hip, pelvis, spine

procedures.name: Ultrasound of the abdomen (complete)
procedures.about: An ultrasound of the liver, gallbladder, pancreas, spleen and kidneys.
procedures.note: Includes the radiologist's reading.
procedures.medicare_description: Complete ultrasound scan of abdomen

procedures.name: Pelvic ultrasound
procedures.about: An ultrasound of the pelvic organs through the abdomen (not through the vagina, which is a different code).
procedures.note: Includes the radiologist's reading.
procedures.medicare_description: Complete ultrasound scan of pelvis
